site.title: AI Tech Demos
site.description: A collection of AI tech demos built with Nuxt v4.

speech.title: Speech
speech.description: Speech synthesis and recognition AI demos.

home.heroDescription: Browse AI tech demos and experience speech synthesis, recognition and more.

demo.backendUnavailable: Backend not ready: create the venv and install deps.
demo.noDemo: No demos in this category yet.

pyodide.title: Python Online Editor
pyodide.inputPlaceholder: stdin input at runtime, for input()…

separation.processing: Separating stems (first run downloads the model), please wait...
separation.cloudUnavailable: Audio separation requires a local Python environment (Demucs) and is not available on cloud deployment. Run pnpm dev locally to use it.
separation.modelHelp: htdemucs for general use; htdemucs_ft fine-tuned; mdx / mdx_extra for higher quality
separation.twoStemsHelp: Outputs vocals and accompaniment by default; pick "Four stems" for all

voiceClone.textRequired: Please enter the text to synthesize

asr.unsupported: This browser does not support SpeechRecognition.
asr.continuousHelp: Keep recognizing until stopped; otherwise stop after one utterance.
asr.interimHelp: Show partial transcripts in real time.

whisper.hint: Pick an audio file and transcribe locally in your browser (no upload; first run downloads the model).
whisper.uploadRequired: Please choose an audio file first
whisper.modelHelp: For Chinese audio use base or small; small is more accurate but slower
whisper.langHelp: Auto-detect may fall back to English on WebGPU; pick Chinese for Chinese audio
whisper.privacy: Audio is processed locally and never uploaded.
whisper.noResult: Pick an audio file and click "Transcribe".
whisper.traditionalNote: Note: Whisper may output Traditional Chinese for Chinese audio (model behavior).

emotion.hint: Record or upload speech and detect its emotion (first run downloads the model).
emotion.uploadRequired: Please record or choose audio first
emotion.noResult: Record or upload audio and click "Analyze".

pitch.hint: Allow the microphone, then speak or sing to see pitch and note in real time.
pitch.noResult: Click "Start" and make a sound into the mic.

denoise.uploadHint: Pick a noisy recording (voice/phone/ambient) and remove noise with DeepFilterNet. First run downloads the model (~30MB).
denoise.noResult: Pick an audio file and click "Denoise".
denoise.cloudUnavailable: Denoising requires a local Python environment (DeepFilterNet) and is not available on cloud deployment. Run pnpm dev locally to use it.

vad.uploadHint: Upload audio and detect speech segments automatically (first run downloads the ~2MB model).
vad.noResult: Pick an audio file and click "Detect".
vad.cloudUnavailable: VAD requires a local Python environment (Silero) and is not available on cloud deployment. Run pnpm dev locally to use it.

musicgen.hint: Describe music in text and let AI generate it (first run downloads the ~1.5GB model).
musicgen.promptPlaceholder: e.g. upbeat electronic dance music with catchy melody
musicgen.note: English prompts work best; the model is under Meta non-commercial license.
musicgen.cloudUnavailable: Music generation requires a local Python environment (MusicGen) and is not available on cloud deployment. Run pnpm dev locally to use it.

visualizer.hint: Upload audio to see its waveform and spectrogram (rendered in-browser with wavesurfer.js).
visualizer.noResult: Pick an audio file to visualize it.

meeting.uploadHint: Upload a meeting/conversation recording; it will be transcribed with speaker labels (first run downloads models).
meeting.noResult: Pick an audio file and click "Generate notes".
meeting.cloudUnavailable: Meeting notes require a local Python environment (faster-whisper + WeSpeaker) and are not available on cloud deployment. Run pnpm dev locally to use it.

midi.uploadHint: Upload solo instrument audio (piano/guitar/bass/saxophone) and convert it to MIDI (first run downloads the model).
midi.noResult: Pick an audio file and click "Transcribe".
midi.cloudUnavailable: Audio to MIDI requires a local Python environment and is not available on cloud deployment. Run pnpm dev locally to use it.

translate.uploadHint: Upload speech in any language; it will be transcribed and translated into English (first run downloads the model).
translate.noResult: Pick an audio file and click "Translate".
translate.cloudUnavailable: Speech translation requires a local Python environment (faster-whisper) and is not available on cloud deployment. Run pnpm dev locally to use it.

lipSync.upload: Please choose a video and audio
lipSync.uploadHint: Upload a short video with a face (<60s) and any audio; AI will lip-sync the face to the audio (first run loads the model, takes minutes).
lipSync.noResult: Pick a video and audio, then click "Start lip sync".
lipSync.cloudUnavailable: Lip sync requires a local Python environment (Wav2Lip) and is not available on cloud deployment. Run pnpm dev locally to use it.

singing.plannedHint: DiffSinger singing synthesis requires a GPU and a trained voice bank (not available on this machine). It is currently planned; the Python example below shows how to integrate it. Try the implemented MusicGen demo in the meantime.

textToImage.modelHelp: Janus-Pro-1B (1.5B, q4 quantized, ~1.2GB first download, then browser cache)
textToImage.promptPlaceholder: Describe the image you want, e.g. a white cat sitting under the moonlight
textToImage.question: Question
textToImage.questionPlaceholder: Ask about this image, e.g. What is in this picture?
textToImage.noWebgpu: WebGPU not detected; falling back to WASM (slower). Use latest Chrome/Edge for best results.
textToImage.firstDownload: First use downloads ~1.2GB of model weights. Please wait.
textToImage.hint: Generation and understanding run locally in this browser; images never leave your device.

inpainting.modelHelp: Moebius-0.2B (~1.24GB first download: UNet 907MB + VAE 335MB, reused via browser cache)
inpainting.pasteHelp: When checked, only the painted region is replaced; the rest of the image stays untouched.
inpainting.paintHint: Paint over the regions you want to remove/fill on the left image, then click "Run inpaint".
inpainting.firstDownload: First run downloads ~1.24GB of model weights and caches them. Please wait.
inpainting.noWebgpu: WebGPU not detected; trying WASM (very slow). Use latest Chrome / Edge / Safari.

capabilities.unsupportedHelp: Use latest Chrome / Edge (enable WebGPU flag in Safari). Browser AI will fall back to WASM.
capabilities.recWebgpu: This environment is good for WebGPU AI demos.
capabilities.recWasm: WebGPU unavailable; browser AI will fall back to WASM (slower).
capabilities.recMemory: Note: integrated GPUs with 2GB VRAM (e.g. Iris Xe) may fail with models >2GB; prefer smaller models.

sdTurbo.modelHelp: SD-Turbo (1-step distilled; ~4-10s per image on CPU; model downloads on first call)
sdTurbo.firstRunNote: The first call downloads and loads the SD-Turbo model on the server (~2.5GB, 1-3 min); afterwards it stays resident.
sdTurbo.promptPlaceholder: Describe the image you want, e.g. a cute cat sitting on a windowsill, digital art

photoRestore.modelHelp: Pipeline: Real-ESRGAN upscale → CodeFormer face restoration. The first call downloads ~450MB of models on the server; please wait.
photoRestore.fidelityHelp: Lower = stronger enhancement (sharper but may change identity); higher = closer to original

mp.clickHint: Click the image to pick a target to segment

params.title: Parameters
params.l2NormalizeHelp: L2-normalize embeddings, typical for cosine similarity.
params.quantizeHelp: Quantize embeddings to bytes to reduce memory.

webllm.empty: Type a message to start chatting (load a model first).
webllm.inputPlaceholder: Type a message, press Enter to send…
webllm.noWebgpu: WebGPU is not available in this browser. Use the latest Chrome/Edge to run WebLLM.
webllm.temperatureHelp: Higher = more random, lower = more deterministic.
webllm.useMirrorHelp: Proxy through hf-mirror.com via local server to bypass CORS and speed up downloads.

tf.question: Question
tf.nerPlaceholder: My name is Sarah and I live in London.
tf.zeroShotPlaceholder: I have exciting news about a new AI model.
tf.summarizePlaceholder: Paste a long text to summarize…
tf.qaQPlaceholder: When was the Eiffel Tower built?
tf.qaCPlaceholder: Paste the context containing the answer…
tf.multiLabelHelp: Allow the text to match multiple labels.
tf.depthInvertHelp: Invert brightness: near becomes dark, far becomes bright.
tf.captionHint: Upload an image to auto-generate a caption.

ml.topKHelp: Number of neighbors considered by the KNN classifier.
ml.captureIntervalHelp: Interval between sample captures during training.
ml.epochsHelp: Number of iterations for neural network training.
ml.overlapFactorHelp: Overlap ratio of audio prediction windows; higher = more sensitive.
ml.probThresholdHelp: Predictions above this value are shown.
ml.renameAfterSamples: Cannot rename after samples are collected; clear the class first

poseTraining.hint: Strike different poses in front of the camera and hold “Collect” to add samples for each class; after training, custom gestures are recognized in real time.

textTraining.hint: Add text samples to each class; after training, any text can be classified in real time. Data stays in your browser.
textTraining.belowThreshold: Below the confidence threshold, no result shown

playground.hint: Pick a dataset and hit “Train” to watch the network learn the decision boundary in real time; you can also click on the canvas to add your own points.
playground.clickHint: Click the canvas to add data points

autoTrain.hint: Upload a CSV, pick the target column, and let it auto-train multiple models with a comparison report. Data is processed on this machine only.
autoTrain.uploadHint: First row must be column names; at least 20 rows and 2 columns
autoTrain.noFile: Please choose a CSV file first
autoTrain.cloudUnavailable: CSV AutoTrain requires a local Python environment (scikit-learn) and is not available on cloud deployment. Run pnpm dev locally to use it.

kmeans.hint: Pick a preset or click the canvas to add points, then step through the clustering process or press play to iterate automatically.
kmeans.clickHint: Click the canvas to add data points

regression.hint: Hit “Train” on the scatter data and watch gradient descent fit a polynomial; you can also click the canvas to add your own points.
regression.clickHint: Click the canvas to add data points

mnist.hint: Load the built-in MNIST dataset and train a neural network in the browser; then draw a digit on the board and hit “Predict”.
mnist.drawHint: Draw a digit (0-9) on the board with your mouse
mnist.drawFirst: Draw a digit on the board, then click “Predict”

cartpole.hint: Hit “Train” and watch the agent learn to balance the inverted pendulum through trial and error; the right panel shows episode steps and best score.

forecast.hint: Upload a CSV with date and value columns, pick the columns and the forecast horizon; an exponential smoothing model is fitted and extrapolated automatically.
forecast.uploadHint: A date column and a numeric column; at least 12 rows
forecast.noFile: Please choose a CSV file first
forecast.noColumns: Please pick the date and value columns
forecast.legend: Blue = history, green dashed = forecast, light green area = 95% confidence band
forecast.cloudUnavailable: Time series forecasting requires a local Python environment (statsmodels) and is not available on cloud deployment. Run pnpm dev locally to use it.

anomaly.hint: Upload a CSV with two numeric features; Isolation Forest finds outliers (red) automatically.
anomaly.uploadHint: Two numeric feature columns; at least 10 rows
anomaly.noFile: Please choose a CSV file first
anomaly.noColumns: Please pick the X and Y columns
anomaly.legend: Blue = normal, red = anomaly, background = model decision region
anomaly.cloudUnavailable: Anomaly detection requires a local Python environment (scikit-learn) and is not available on cloud deployment. Run pnpm dev locally to use it.

palette.hint: Upload any image and K-Means extracts the dominant colors in your browser; change K to recompute.
palette.noResult: Upload an image to extract its palette
palette.noPixels: Too few pixels or the image is fully transparent

dimReduction.hint: Upload a CSV with numeric columns, pick a method and cluster count, and see the high-dimensional data in 2D.
dimReduction.uploadHint: Multiple numeric feature columns; at least 10 rows
dimReduction.noFile: Please choose a CSV file first
dimReduction.legend: Each dot is a sample; color = K-Means cluster
dimReduction.cloudUnavailable: Dim reduction requires a local Python environment (scikit-learn) and is not available on cloud deployment. Run pnpm dev locally to use it.

svd.hint: Enter a MovieLens user ID (1-943); SVD matrix factorization predicts ratings for unseen movies and recommends the Top-10.
svd.error: Recommendation failed (first run downloads data and trains, please wait)
svd.cloudUnavailable: The recommender requires a local Python environment (numpy + MovieLens data) and is not available on cloud deployment. Run pnpm dev locally to use it.

decisionTree.hint: Pick a dataset and max depth, then hit “Build” to grow a CART decision tree with Gini impurity; the left shows the decision boundary, the right the tree structure.

flappy.hint: Hit “Start” — each bird is controlled by a neural network; each generation the top scorers are cloned and mutated, and after a few generations they learn to fly through the pipes.

image.uploadHint: Click or drag an image here (PNG / JPG / WebP; longest side auto-resized to 2048px)
image.replaceHint: Dropping a new image will replace the current one
image.clickHint: Click the result canvas to inspect pixels
image.secondImageHint: Click or drag a second image (used by two-image tools like feature matching)

faceStudio.photosHint: Select multiple at once; for group photos click a face thumbnail to choose which face to use
faceStudio.faceSelectHint: Click a thumbnail to choose the face
faceStudio.name: Name
faceStudio.registerHint: Upload multiple photos of the same person from different angles/lighting for better accuracy
faceStudio.registerEmpty: Upload at least one photo with a detected face first
faceStudio.recognizeHint: Upload one or more photos to compare against the registry
faceStudio.recognizeEmpty: Upload at least one photo with a detected face first
faceStudio.empty: No faces registered yet — register one above
faceStudio.storageNote: The registry is stored in this browser (localStorage); it will be lost in another browser or after clearing cache
faceStudio.firstRunNote: First use loads the insightface model (buffalo_l, ~300MB); please wait
faceStudio.cameraNotReady: Camera is not ready yet, try again
faceStudio.liveHint: Live recognition updates every 2–5 s; results are overlaid on the video (model loads on first frame)
faceStudio.cameraUnsupported: Camera is not supported in this browser (requires HTTPS or localhost)
faceStudio.cameraPermission: Cannot access camera, please check permission
faceStudio.cameraPermissionDenied: Camera permission denied; allow it in the browser and retry
faceStudio.cameraInUse: Camera is in use by another app; close it and retry

image.noTools: No tools available on this page yet.
